tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Default ground for body copy in `ink` and `muted`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised ground: panels (StatusPanel), terminal windows, highlight cards and the command box.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on `paper`, `surface` and `tbar`; also the fill of a pressed Segmented option (label in `paper`).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: section subtitles, card descriptions, prompt output, chip labels, file names, labels. Also the Accordion `+` and the StatusPanel idle ring (icons, 3:1+). On `paper`, `surface` and `tbar` (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Decoration only: rail labels, the `##` before Prose h2s, Contents numbers, a FeatureList arrow at rest. 2.5:1 on `paper` light, 3.7:1 dark: never use it for readable text or for icons that carry meaning.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside a structure: rules between FeatureList rows and StatStrip cells, table rules, the timeline spine, Accordion and RuledColumns rules, Contents rule. The big faint FeatureList and HighlightCard numerals are also `line`.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The structural rule, after herdr.dev/tui: the Frame's side rules, Section and StatStrip borders, and the 1px border of every button, panel, card and command box. Stronger than `line`, which stays for rules inside a list. 1.5:1 on `paper` light and 1.8:1 dark, under the 3:1 control-border floor, as herdr.dev/tui's own rule is; labels and glyphs identify every control, and hover, focus and press states are 3:1+.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: The 72px background grid outside the Frame (`grid-size`). Decorative only.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Terminal title-bar dots. 1.5:1 on `surface` light, 2.1:1 dark: decoration only.

tokens.name: underline
tokens.usage: The 1px rule under a ruled link (TextLink `variant="rule"`, links in Prose, Footer and Accordion answers), borrowed from herdr.dev. Hover swaps it for `accent`. An alias of `node-stroke` in light and `dot` in dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: links, the `#![arian]` prompt, the emphasised word in a display headline, the solid button fill, the eyebrow and its rule, hover fills of ghost buttons, the Material 3 state layer and ripple on rows and cells, the focus ring, hashtags, role lines, list dashes. Text on `paper`, `surface` and `accent-soft` (9.3:1 light, 5.8:1 dark). herdr.dev/tui uses purple here; this brand keeps its blue.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text: inline code, RuledColumns code chips, the hovered terminal title bar, the timeline node halo.

tokens.name: accent-ring
tokens.usage: From the site: a soft ring behind focused or active accent elements. These components use the Material 3 focus ring instead, so nothing here uses it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill: solid buttons, a hovered ghost button, the HEAD tag. Dark in the dark theme because the accent lightens.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Material 3 inverse surface: the Tooltip container. Dark in the light theme, light in the dark theme.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `inverse` (Tooltip label): 17:1 light, 13:1 dark.

tokens.name: sel-bg
tokens.usage: Text selection background — alias of `accent`.

tokens.name: sel-fg
tokens.usage: Text selection foreground — alias of `on-accent`.

tokens.name: tbar
tokens.usage: Terminal window title bar behind the three dots and the file name.

tokens.name: tbar-line
tokens.usage: Rule under the terminal title bar.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb (`scrollbar-color` in bundle.css). An alias of `dot`.

tokens.name: nav
tokens.usage: The always-dark chrome in both themes: top nav, the profile hero, status bar, code blocks, ask button.

tokens.name: nav-edge
tokens.usage: Hairline on `nav`: status-bar top border, code-block border, the rule between Segmented options on the dark chrome.

tokens.name: nav-line
tokens.usage: Borders on `nav`: the nav's bottom rule, hero chips, buttons, the ⌘K and menu buttons, the LIGHT | DARK toggle, the ask button. Source value is 1.7:1 on `nav`, under the 3:1 control-border floor; each control's label carries the affordance.

tokens.name: nav-link
tokens.usage: Resting nav links and muted text on `nav` (6.9:1).

tokens.name: nav-hi
tokens.usage: Hovered or current nav link, the ask-button label on `nav`.

tokens.name: nav-ink
tokens.usage: Code text in `pre` blocks and diagram labels on `nav`.

tokens.name: nav-accent
tokens.usage: Accent on `nav` in both themes: the ~/AS logo, the hero role, prompts, the hero's solid button fill (label `on-nav-accent`). 6.3:1 on `nav`.

tokens.name: on-nav-accent
tokens.usage: Label on a `nav-accent` fill — the hero's solid "contact →" button.

tokens.name: hero-hi
tokens.usage: Hero name and prompt text on the dark chrome; labels of buttons there; the fill of a pressed Segmented option on `nav` (label in `nav`).

tokens.name: pcb-trace
tokens.usage: Decorative circuit-board traces in corners and rails.

tokens.name: pcb-flow
tokens.usage: Animated packet / flow line along a trace.

tokens.name: pcb-via
tokens.usage: Circuit vias (small rings) on traces.

tokens.name: node-stroke
tokens.usage: Outline of architecture-diagram nodes on `paper`; also the light value of `underline` and `line-strong`.

tokens.name: dim-hair
tokens.usage: Dimension-line hairline (the scroll ruler under the nav).

tokens.name: dim-tick
tokens.usage: Dimension-line end ticks.

tokens.name: dim-lbl
tokens.usage: Dimension-line label ("0px · 0%").

tokens.name: reg-mark
tokens.usage: The small "+" registration mark in a highlight card's corner.

tokens.name: rail-txt
tokens.usage: Vertical status-rail text along the left edge (decorative).

tokens.name: fold-hi
tokens.usage: Lit facets and the edge highlight of a crumpled `paper` sheet (CrumpleEdge). Each facet multiplies it by its own strength.

tokens.name: fold-lo
tokens.usage: Shaded facets of a crumpled `paper` sheet (CrumpleEdge).

tokens.name: fold-shadow
tokens.usage: The soft shadow a crumpled hero edge casts on the block below: blurred 3.5px, 4px down. With `elev-fab`, the only shadow in the system.

tokens.name: nav-fold-hi
tokens.usage: Lit facets and edge highlight when the crumpled sheet is the dark `nav` (the profile Hero).

tokens.name: nav-fold-lo
tokens.usage: Shaded facets when the crumpled sheet is the dark `nav`.

styles.name: hero-name
styles.usage: Your name in the hero, `hero-hi` on `nav`. One per page.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: H1 of an inner page (blog post, tutorial). Scales down to 26px on narrow screens.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: H2 of every home section, under its `secmark` prompt. Scales 26–34px.

styles.name: hero-tagline
styles.usage: The "Building systems that are …" line under the role, in `muted`; the rotating word in `accent`.

styles.name: prose-h2
styles.sample: Why Go for the control plane
styles.usage: H2 inside long-form prose, over a `line` rule.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Title of a terminal card or timeline entry, in `ink`.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: The Hero statement headline in Archivo 900, one word in `accent` (wrap it in `<em>`). Scales 38–132px. One per page.

styles.name: display-end
styles.usage: The closing statement above the Footer, and SectionHeader `display`. Scales 36–70px, max 13ch.

styles.name: feature-num
styles.usage: The big numeral of a FeatureList row or HighlightCard, in `line` so it barely shows.

styles.name: stat-num
styles.usage: The figure in a StatStrip cell or StatTile, tabular. Scales 26–40px.

styles.name: feature-title
styles.usage: Title of a FeatureList row, followed by a `→` that slides on hover.

styles.name: role
styles.usage: The hero role line, in `nav-accent`.

styles.name: prompt
styles.usage: Terminal prompt lines (`#![arian] whoami`): `#![` and `]` in `accent` at weight 700, the name at 400.

styles.name: secmark
styles.usage: Section kicker above a section title: `#![arian] cat ./01_about.md`, in `muted`, the prompt in `accent`.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels, set UPPERCASE (herdr.dev/tui). Also the nav's ghost button.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrow over a display headline, UPPERCASE in `accent` after a 42px `accent` rule.

styles.name: label-caps
styles.usage: UPPERCASE labels in `faint`/`muted`: StatStrip labels, panel headers, the mode toggle (.16em), tags.

styles.name: link
styles.usage: Stand-alone mono links (`lnk`) in `accent`, underline grows on hover.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Top-nav links, lowercase, in `nav-link`.

styles.name: hashtag
styles.usage: Hashtags in `accent` after the hero chips.

styles.name: skill-label
styles.usage: Skill-group headings, set UPPERCASE in `accent`.

styles.name: role-line
styles.usage: Role under a card title ("Owner & Platform Engineer"), in `accent`.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Chips, the ⌘K button, commit hashes, periods.

styles.name: statusbar
styles.usage: The fixed bottom status bar, in `nav-link`.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Badges on the timeline (employment type, HEAD), set UPPERCASE.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Backend Engineer with 8+ years of experience (since 2018).
styles.usage: Default copy, hero paragraph (in `muted` on the hero).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Backend Engineer with 8+ years of experience, four of them building cloud platform products in Go.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a display headline, in `muted`, max 56ch; wrap the one sentence that matters in `<b>` for `ink`.

styles.name: prose
styles.sample: Kubernetes at a working level — namespaces, NetworkPolicy, quotas.
styles.usage: Long-form blog and tutorial text.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Platforms I own and operate end to end — product, architecture, and infrastructure.
styles.usage: Section subtitle under a section title, `muted`, max 60ch.

styles.name: card-body
styles.sample: Multi-tenant PaaS where users deploy ready-made applications.
styles.usage: Card descriptions (`muted`) and highlight-card text (`ink`).

styles.name: list
styles.usage: Bulleted achievements in cards and timeline, each led by an `accent` em dash.

styles.name: tooltip
styles.usage: Tooltip label: Material 3 body-small (12/16, .025rem), `on-inverse` on `inverse`.

spacing.note: The values the CSS really repeats, named by pixel size. space-34, 40, 46, 96 and 104 come from herdr.dev/tui's frame and sections.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hashtag and link-underline padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Terminal title-bar gap, list item spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Title-bar vertical padding, chip-row gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Chip horizontal padding, gap under section titles.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Title-bar horizontal padding, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap under `secmark`, between hashtags, under card lists.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between a structure rule and the content under it (RuledColumns).

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Terminal body vertical padding, prose paragraph margin.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Card and terminal horizontal padding; page gutter.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Prose block margins (pre, table, blockquote).

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Prose h3 top margin and hr margin, the gap between RuledColumns, space above the lede in the statement Hero.

tokens.name: space-34

tokens.name: space-36

tokens.name: space-40

tokens.name: space-46
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of a compact Section (figure blocks).

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Timeline entry indent (clears the spine and node).

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Hero bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-72
tokens.usage: Hero top padding.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Top padding of a full Section.

tokens.name: space-104
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of a full Section.

tokens.name: radius-square
tokens.usage: Everything with a corner: buttons, panels, cards, terminal windows, the command box, chips, badges, tooltips, code blocks and images in Prose. herdr.dev/tui is square.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: The ~/AS app-icon tile (12 on a 64 square).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Terminal dots and timeline nodes.

tokens.name: elev-fab
tokens.usage: The floating ask button.

tokens.name: ring-node
tokens.usage: Halo round an active timeline node.

tokens.name: grid-size
tokens.usage: Cell size of the background grid outside the Frame.

tokens.name: frame-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the Frame, the ruled page column (herdr.dev/tui).

tokens.name: wrap-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the centred content column (`wrap`) inside a Section.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of section subtitles.

tokens.name: statusbar-height
tokens.usage: Height of the fixed bottom status bar; body has the same bottom padding.

tokens.name: nav-breakpoint
tokens.usage: Where layouts fold (a literal in the CSS, since media and container queries can't read variables): the NavBar's links become a menu below 820px of its own width; FeatureList, RuledColumns and StatStrip stack below an 820px viewport.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Material 3 focus indicator thickness; it pulses to 8px on arrival.

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its focus ring (M3 outer offset).

state.note: Material 3 interaction states (google/material-web md.sys.state). Each is an opacity for a layer of the content colour (`currentColor`; `accent` on rows and cells) over a control.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: State layer while hovered: buttons, Segmented options, COPY, nav controls, linked FeatureList rows and StatStrip cells.

tokens.name: state-focus
tokens.usage: State layer while keyboard-focused, together with the focus ring.

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: Peak opacity of the press ripple.

tokens.name: state-dragged
tokens.usage: State layer while dragged. Nothing drags yet; reserved.

tokens.name: state-disabled
tokens.usage: Opacity of a disabled control's content (`:disabled`, `aria-disabled`). No state layer or ripple.
